description: Unit tests for Orleans message serialization functionality, including tests for TTL updates, size constraints, and backwards compatibility.

classes.name: MessageSerializerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for Orleans message serialization and cache invalidation handling, testing TTL updates, size constraints, and backward compatibility.

classes.name: MessageSerializerBackwardsCompatibilityStub
classes.description: A stub class used internally within tests to simulate reading and writing cache invalidation headers for backward compatibility testing.

methods.name: MessageTest_TtlUpdatedOnAccess
methods.description: Tests that the TTL is updated correctly when a message is accessed.

methods.name: MessageTest_TtlUpdatedOnSerialization
methods.description: Tests that the TTL is preserved and updated correctly during serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: Message_SerializeHeaderTooBig
methods.description: Tests that serialization throws an exception when message header exceeds maximum allowed size.

methods.name: Message_SerializeBodyTooBig
methods.description: Tests that serialization throws an exception when message body exceeds maximum allowed size.

methods.name: Message_DeserializeHeaderTooBig
methods.description: Tests deserialization handling when message header size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: Message_DeserializeBodyTooBig
methods.description: Tests deserialization handling when message body size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: DeserializeFakeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a fake message with specified header and body size for testing size limits.

methods.name: RoundTripMessage
methods.description: Serializes and then deserializes a message to verify correctness.

methods.name: MessageTest_CacheInvalidationHeader_RoundTripCompatibility
methods.description: Tests cache invalidation headers serialization/deserialization for backward compatibility, involving conversions between old and new formats.
